items.title: He’s Betting Against Uber’s Entire Business Model
items.summary: Uber rides have gotten expensive, but on some trips drivers take home less than half the fare. Throo, Uber's newest competitor, charges drivers no commission, just a flat $1 fee per ride.*Spot the next industries ripe for disruption:* https://clickhubspot.com/dieaBehind the gap is a 2022 switch from a simple time-and-distance pay formula to an algorithm that sets what riders pay and what drivers earn. Now a Singapore-based rideshare startup, Throo (called TADA in Singapore), is betting against Uber’s entire business model.
